newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: GOLF-O'MALLEY BACK TO FORM WITH A 65.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-O'MALLEY BACK TO FORM WITH A 65.

text.p: Australian Peter O'Malley returned to form on the Aroiera course in Lisbon when he shot a seven-under-par 65 in the opening round of the Portuguese Open on Thursday.

O'Malley beat most of Europe's best to capture the Benson and Hedges International at St Melion two years ago but has since struggled with his short game until losing a play-off for the recent Australian Masters to Peter Lonard.

"I have been working hard on chipping and putting with my coach Denis Pugh in recent weeks," said O'Malley after producing seven birdies in a faultless performance on the thickly wooded seaside course.
It gave him a one-stroke advantage over Swedish newcomer Max Anglert who relaxes during the long Scandinavian winter by playing ice hockey three times a week.
Jose Maria Olazabal continued his successful comeback from an 18-month layoff because of foot problems with a solid 70.

He was then presented with the Johnnie Walker golfer of the month award for February as recognition of his 12th placing in the Dubai Desert Classic -- his first tournament after his spell out of the game.
"Everything is going well," said the former U.S. Masters champion. "I look forward to the day when I just walk on to the course and do not think about my feet."
European Ryder Cup captain Seve Ballesteros struggled to a 73.
